subject: Vendr portal: SSO provisioning + retention evidence needed
messages:
From: onboarding@vendr.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@acme-labs.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding - initial checklist and SSO requirements

Hi Ben,

Thanks for starting the Vendr onboarding for Redwood Inference. To complete your profile and enable procurement workflows for Acme Labs we need the following items uploaded into the Vendr portal by 2026-06-22:

- SAML metadata (IdP) for your staging environment
- SCIM token for user provisioning (or confirm you will do manual provisioning)
- Evidence of your data retention policy for logs and backups (PDF or link)
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy acceptable)
- A short CSV mapping evidence owners for each control (who owns what)

Portal link: https://portal.vendr.com/orgs/redwood-inference/onboarding/1729
Staging SSO test slots: 2026-06-17 09:00-11:00 PT or 2026-06-18 14:00-16:00 PT (we can open a calendar invite).

If you prefer, we can accept a temporary SAML metadata file via email for staging only.

Regards,
Katrina Mills
Vendr - Onboarding
onboarding@vendr.com

Attachment: vendr-onboarding-checklist.pdf (stub)

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700

Katrina,

Thanks — looping in Mina (Security) and Marcus (Infra) to own the artifacts. High level plan from our side:

1) I'll upload a filled evidence-owner CSV and a redacted SOC2 PDF by EOD 6/16.
2) Marcus will produce a staging SAML metadata file and share via email (staging only).
3) Mina will prepare a short retention policy excerpt and a redaction guidance doc for logs.

We're targeting the 6/18 14:00 PT SSO test slot — please send a calendar invite.

Attachments: vendor-evidence-owner-matrix.csv; sso-reqs.md

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0102

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - initial checklist and SSO requirements

Ben / team,

Quick notes from Security on evidence scope and constraints: we can share the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), a KMS architecture diagram, and redacted audit-log samples — but not full production logs or PII. Please ensure:

- Redactions remove user identifiers and IPs; keep timestamps and event types.
- KMS diagram should show key separation (prod vs staging) and KMS provider (AWS KMS) with customer-managed keys called out if applicable.
- Retention policy excerpt should state retention period and deletion policy (e.g., logs retained 90 days, backups retained 365 days).

I'll attach our redaction-guidelines.pdf and will own the SOC2 redaction step. Marcus — we need the staging SAML metadata and an answer on whether SCIM will be enabled for the Vendr test org.

Mina Haddad
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: redaction-guidelines.pdf

From: sso-team@vendr.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - SAML metadata and staging slot confirmed

Hi team,

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming the 2026-06-18 14:00 PT SSO test slot and we've provisioned a Vendr staging org for Redwood (ticket #1729). Actions for Redwood: please upload the staging SAML metadata file and, if using SCIM, provide a temporary SCIM bearer token with contributor scope for the test org (we will not retain the token after test).

We can accept the SOC2 redacted PDF and a sample_redacted_audit_logs.zip (zipped CSVs). Please do not include PII fields. Once you upload the artifacts we will perform a compliance intake and mark the account as "Portal: Ready for procurement" for Acme Labs.

Portal intake link: https://portal.vendr.com/orgs/redwood-inference/onboarding/1729
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=vendr-staging-sso-test

Regards,
Sam Lee
SSO Team, Vendr
sso-team@vendr.com

Attachment: vendr-staging-setup-instructions.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: sso-team@vendr.com, onboarding@vendr.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding - SAML metadata and staging slot confirmed

Sam / Katrina,

Uploading the requested items now (staging-only SAML + redacted evidence). Summary of uploads and notes:

- sso-metadata-redwood.xml (staging SAML metadata) — uses test-idp.redwood-inference.internal; assertionConsumerService URL points at vendr-staging.
- SOC2_Redwood_Redacted.pdf — redacted per Mina's guidelines (removed PII and external auditor comments).
- sample_redacted_audit_logs.zip — contains three CSVs: auth_events.csv, admin_changes.csv, retention_events.csv (timestamps only; no IPs).
- vendor-evidence-owner-matrix.csv — completed with owners and phone/email.

Marcus: SCIM is being left disabled for the staging test; manual provisioning confirmed.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
